Package org.jlab.coda.emu.support.transport

Interface DataTransport

All Superinterfaces:
CODAStateMachine, StatedObject
All Known Implementing Classes:
DataTransportAdapter, DataTransportImplCmsg, DataTransportImplEmu, DataTransportImplEt, DataTransportImplFifo, DataTransportImplFile, DataTransportImplTcpStream, DataTransportImplUdpStream
public interface DataTransport extends CODAStateMachine, StatedObject
This interface defines how data is transported and does not refer to a particular data connection.

    • createChannel

      DataChannel createChannel(String name, Map<String,String> attributeMap, boolean isInput, Emu emu, EmuModule module, int outputIndex, int streamNumber) throws org.jlab.coda.emu.support.transport.DataTransportException
      This method creates a DataChannel object.
      Parameters:
      name - name of DataChannel
      attributeMap - hashmap of attributes taken from XML config file
      isInput - true if this channel puts data into the Emu, else false
      emu - Emu owning this transport
      module - module creating this channel
      outputIndex - order in which module's events will be sent to this output channel (0 for first output channel, 1 for next, etc.).
      streamNumber - when creating multiple channels from one entry in the config file (ie VTP has mulitple streams), this number uniquely identifies the particular stream of that single source. Defaults to 0. output channel (0 for first output channel, 1 for next, etc.).
      Returns:
      DataChannel object
      Throws:
      org.jlab.coda.emu.support.transport.DataTransportException - if transport problem

    • getTransportClass

      String getTransportClass()
      This method gets the name of the transport class implementing this interface. It's the part of the name which comes after "org.jlab.coda.emu.support.transport.DataTransportImpl". Thus it may have values of Et, Emu, Cmsg, File, TcpStream, UdpStream, etc.
      Returns:
      the name of the transport class implementing this interface.

    • getChannel

      DataChannel getChannel(int id, int streamNumber)
      This method gets the specified channel associated with this transport. Only implemented for DataChannelImplEmu and DataChannelImpTcpStream.
      Parameters:
      id - id associated with channel
      streamNumber - stream number associated with channel (if any).
      Returns:

    • getInputChannelTable

      HashMap<Integer,DataChannel> getInputChannelTable()
      Get the table of input channels, if any. Currently only implemented by Emu, TcpStream, and UdpStream transports. The map key is the coda ID, the value is the data channel object.
      Returns:
      table of input channels, if any, else null.
